_meta.description: German Kfz licence-plate district codes -> district seat, derived from Wikidata P395. Applied under the manual overrides in monocular_osm/kfz_codes.py.
resolution: 1 current urban district carrying the code -> the city (name match first when several carry it)
2 district carrying it (current, then dissolved) whose seat (P36) name matches the code (same first letter, all code letters in it)
3 else the seat of a current, then of a dissolved district
4 codes no district carries -> municipality whose name starts with the code, else the most populous carrier
seats with an end-time qualifier rank below current ones
statements of retired plate systems (ended <= 1956-07-01 or in 1990, i.e. occupation-zone and GDR codes) are dropped
